title: 第9章 衰老的可怕想要长生久视的陆云第10章 人老了不得不服输以往的恩怨
slug: 我武举人晚年才来武学修改器
content_zh:
想到这里，李彪脸上的肥肉抽搐了几下，瞬间换上了一副公事公办的表情。
他重重咳了一声，把还剩大半截的烟头扔在地上，用靴底碾灭。
“行了！
都别围着了！
那个谁……张弘是吧？带着你的人，赶紧把这里收拾干净！
妨碍交通，像什么话！”
教训完张弘之后，李彪挥了挥手，对身后的警员吩咐道：“去几个人，把尸体先抬回局里，登记一下……嗯，就说……疑似帮派斗殴，互殴致死！”
“让家属……呃，让义顺堂那边自己来认领！
其他人，收队！”
说完，他看也不再看张弘那谄媚的表情，转身就往卡车驾驶室走去。
流连酒楼赌坊、搂抱粉头娇娘、搜刮油水好处，这些享乐营生他李彪是样样精通。
至于帮派之间的乱斗浑水，他是一丁点儿也不想浪费时间和宝贵的精力去管。
陆家大宅，幽静的庭院内。
陆福垂手侍立，嘴唇微动，似乎有话想说，但一旁的陆景武彻底按捺不住内心的狂涛骇浪，抢前一步开口。
“大伯父！
您难道……难道真的……”
陆云端坐在石桌旁，端起一杯热茶轻轻啜了一口。
“嗯，近来偶有所得，略进了一步。”
“可是……”
，陆景武还想追问，却被陆云抬手打断。

“好了，不必多说。”
陆云放下茶杯，目光扫过二人，“你们且去吧。”
“阿福，景腾那边劳你多费心照料，景武，贸易行上下的生意你先盯着。”
“遇事不决，可来问我。”
若是放在从前，家中产业出了这样的乱子，陆云一定会亲自出山坐镇，统领全局。
但如今，陆家的所有产业在他眼里都不重要了，最重要的就是脑海中的“极蓝武学修改器”
他必须抓住这迟来了六十年的机缘，穷尽一切可能，获取更多的修改值。
陆玄的目标超脱了世俗的权势与财富，指向了一个更加虚无缥缈的终极梦想。
长生久视！
尤其是他亲身经历过气血衰败、肉身朽坏的折磨，眼睁睁看着时间无情的流走，陆云比任何人都更加恐惧衰老。
死亡，意味着一切归零，意味着这六十年风雨、拼搏、荣辱、爱憎……所有的一切都将化为尘土，再无意义。
他绝不能接受！
庭院外，陆景武几乎是拽着陆福的手臂衣袖，将他拉到了回廊拐角。
“福叔叔！
您听到了吗？您听清楚了吗？大伯父他……他承认了！
他是化劲宗师！
化劲啊！
我的天！”
面对陆景武的欣喜若狂，陆福只是平静的点头：“我听见了，武少爷。”
“我就知道！

大伯父天纵奇才！
当年能以寒门之身力压群雄，夺得武举人的功名，我就知道他不是凡人！”
陆景武激动得来回踱步，“化劲宗师……哈哈哈！
content_en:
Thinking of this, the fat on Li Biao's face twitched a few times, and he instantly put on a business-like expression.
He coughed heavily, threw the remaining half of the cigarette butt on the ground, and crushed it with the sole of his boot.
"Okay!
Stop hanging around!
Who is that... Zhang Hong, right? Take your people and clean up this place quickly!
Impeding traffic, what a word! "
After teaching Zhang Hong a lesson, Li Biao waved his hand and told the police officer behind him: "Go and bring the body back to the station first, and register it... Well, let's just say... it's suspected of a gang fight, and they beat each other to death!"
"Let the family members... uh, let Yishun Hall claim it themselves!
Everyone else, stop the team! "
After saying that, he no longer looked at Zhang Hong's flattering expression, turned around and walked towards the truck cab.
Li Biao was proficient in all these hedonistic pursuits: hanging around restaurants and gambling houses, hugging pink-haired girls, and searching for profits.
As for the turbulent fighting between gangs, he didn't want to waste any time or precious energy on it.
Lu family mansion, in the quiet courtyard.
Lu Fu stood with his hands lowered, his lips moving slightly, as if he had something to say, but Lu Jingwu on the side couldn't control the turmoil in his heart and took a step forward to speak.
"Uncle!
Are you...are you really..."
Lu Yun sat at the stone table, picked up a cup of hot tea and took a sip.
"Well, I have gained something occasionally recently, and I have made a little progress."
"But..."
, Lu Jingwu wanted to ask more, but was interrupted by Lu Yun raising his hand.
"Okay, no need to say more."
Lu Yun put down his tea cup and glanced at the two of them, "You go ahead."
"Ah Fu, please take care of Jing Teng. Jing Wu, please keep an eye on the business of the trading house first."
"Whenever you're in doubt, come and ask me."
If in the past, if such a mess happened to the family property, Lu Yun would definitely come out personally and take charge of the overall situation.
But now, all the Lu family's properties are not important in his eyes. The most important thing is the "Ultra Blue Martial Arts Modifier" in his mind.
He must seize this opportunity that has been delayed for sixty years and do everything possible to obtain more modified values.
Lu Xuan's goal transcends worldly power and wealth and points to a more elusive ultimate dream.
See you forever!
Especially since he had personally experienced the torment of blood decay and physical decay, and watched helplessly as time passed by ruthlessly, Lu Yun was more afraid of aging than anyone else.
Death means that everything will return to zero, that everything in these sixty years of hard work, honor and disgrace, love and hate... will be turned into dust and will be meaningless.
He can never accept it!
Outside the courtyard, Lu Jingwu almost grabbed Lu Fu's arm and sleeve and pulled him to the corner of the corridor.
"Uncle Fu!
Did you hear that? Did you hear that clearly? Uncle, he...he admitted it!
He is the master of Huajin!
Transform your energy!
Oh my God! "
Facing Lu Jingwu's ecstasy, Lu Fu just nodded calmly: "I heard it, Master Wu."
"I knew it!
Uncle is a genius!
Back then, when he was able to defeat the heroes and win the title of martial arts scholar with his humble family, I knew he was no ordinary person! "
Lu Jingwu was so excited that he paced back and forth, "Master Huajin... hahaha!
